messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – 24-month frame proposal for part:350020
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer. We would like to renew for longer and give Selvbrunn planning security.

Our bottom-up should-cost cost:350020 puts this converter at 403.21 EUR per unit, before margin.

Our forecast fc:350020@2026-09 records a volume change of 10.3%, which supports a stable multi-year frame.

The attached term sheets cover 4580 pcs per year over 24 or 36 months. Our current agreement runs on 90-day payment terms, and continuing them would help both sides. Your sales director said you are open on payment terms. If the price element exceeds your approval limit, could you please put it to your pricing committee? Could you also confirm the earliest lead time and any cheaper variant?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – 24-month frame proposal for part:350020
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
For your information:
As to the volume change and should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.
We welcome your proposal for a longer-term commitment and are prepared to extend the contract to 36 months with 60-day payment terms.
Taking your volume forecast and should-cost data into account, we can offer a revised price of €430.68 per unit for this package.
Our engineering and logistics departments will provide detailed answers regarding lead times and alternative variants shortly.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net and a contract term of 36 months: €430.68 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Application Engineering:
From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 15.94 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 11.23 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 7.02 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Renewal 4600070530 - revised packages for pricing committee review
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for the revised offer and for keeping the 90-day payment terms.

Your scorecard sc:70530@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 84.6%, which our planners must buffer at their own cost.

The attached term sheets keep the full 4580 pcs per year and 90-day payment. One covers 24 months and one covers 36 months, which gives Selvbrunn long-term planning security. We understand that price changes above 2% need your pricing committee. Could you please submit these packages to its next session for an authorized review?

Could you also tell us what improvement plan you have for delivery reliability? Do you see any cheaper design or packaging variant?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

Our engineering and logistics departments will address your questions regarding technical variants and delivery improvements separately.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
